units.name: 죽은자 창병
units.bodyDescription: 인간형 5등신 뼈대 · 숙인 고개 · 하이앵글 프론트뷰
units.prompt: Rebuild ONE complete production transparent PIXEL game token. INPUT1 original character controls EXACT costume/hair/helmet/beard/palette/weapons, elevated FRONT camera, deeply BOWED hidden face and distinct action silhouette; preserve those identity details. INPUT2 neutral HUMAN skeleton controls EXACT FIVE anatomical crown-to-chin heads for crown-to-sole body, ordinary adult skull and shoulder/pelvis/knee/ankle bone lengths, crisp pixel density/stepped dark outlines/short restrained shade ramps. Redress and rotate original neutral bones into INPUT1 action, NEVER lengthen to6–8heads, shrink to4heads or inflate helmet/skull. Slim/muscular/fat changes WIDTH only. Elevated front camera down40–45degrees with crown and both shoulder TOPS obvious, torso/face foreshortened. Head firmly tucked down, eyes covered by hair/helmet/hood/brow; NO frontal facial portrait/eye contact. Retain original body's forward lean or combat action. Do not default to template's walking pose: grounded/braced feet or original lunging as equipment/action warrants, varied lead foot, uncrossed coherent limbs. Complete exact original weapons with logical handgrips; no weapons borrowed from INPUT2. Full silhouette and ALL weapon/banner/antler tips inside INNER80percent canvas. Body center ignores equipment. Transparent background, no base/floor/shadow/scenery/text/watermark/extra figures. Character identity: 죽은자 창병 (dead_spearman). EXACT original loadout/palette/materials/action from INPUT1. Five anatomical heads crown-to-sole, helmet/crown not skull. Preserve original restrained spectral sea-green/grey material and ragged armor; single visible coherent body, no mist floor or effects.  CRITICAL CORRECTION: spear tip must stop at least100pixels below top canvas edge. Full spear, body and feet inside inner75percent canvas. Increase canvas; NEVER compress anatomical bones. Keep original green spectral armor and SPEAR.
